children.text: How to Install Meetily on Windows & macOS: Complete Setup Guide
Step-by-step guide to installing Meetily on Windows and macOS. Covers Community (free open source), Pro free trial, and Pro paid versions with screenshots and troubleshooting.

children.alt: How to install Meetily on Windows and macOS - step by step setup guide

children.text: Meetily installs in under 5 minutes on Windows or macOS. There are three ways to get started: Community Edition (free, open source), Pro Free Trial (14 days, no credit card), or Pro ($10/user/month billed annually). All versions run 100% locally - your meeting data never leaves your device.
Meetily runs entirely on your device. There are no cloud dependencies, no accounts required for the Community edition, and no bots joining your meetings.

Community is best if you want free, open source meeting transcription - it runs the same local engine as Pro. Pro adds speaker identification, auto-detect meetings, custom AI model connectors, and advanced exports. Start with Community if unsure - you can upgrade anytime.
Option 1: Install Meetily Community (Free, Open Source)
The Community Edition is free with no hidden costs. It includes real-time transcription, AI-powered summaries, and 100% local processing.
Go to meetily.ai/downloads and select your platform (macOS or Windows). The site auto-detects your operating system.
Click "Download for macOS" or "Download for Windows" under the Community card.
Drag Meetily to your Applications folder
Launch Meetily from the Start menu or desktop shortcut
Windows may show a SmartScreen warning for new applications. Click "More info" then "Run anyway" to proceed.
Configure your audio input (microphone or system audio)
Click Record to start capturing your meeting
Meetily transcribes in real-time and generates summaries when you stop
All recordings saved locally on your device
Option 2: Start a Free Pro Trial (14 Days, No Credit Card)
The Pro trial gives you full access to all Pro features for 14 days. No credit card required.
Go to meetily.ai and click "Start free trial" on the homepage
Meetily homepage showing the Start free trial button alongside Book a demo and Watch Demo options
You can also start a trial from the pricing page by clicking "Request a free trial" on the Pro card.
Fill in the trial request form: your name, work email, and company name are required. Designation, evaluation type, and how you heard about Meetily are optional.
Start Your 14-Day Pro Trial form showing fields for name, work email, company name, designation, evaluation type, and referral source with a Get My License Key button
Click "Get My License Key" to submit
The system processes your request in a few seconds. You will see a progress indicator stepping through submission, evaluation, license generation, and preparation.
Trial request processing modal showing Step 4 of 4 - Preparing your details with a progress bar
Once approved, the modal shows "Your License is Approved!" (Step 1 of 2). Choose your platform - macOS or Windows - and click to start the download.
Your License is Approved modal showing Step 1 of 2 with macOS and Windows download buttons
The download starts immediately in your browser. For macOS, the file is a .dmg installer. For Windows, it is an .exe setup file.
Browser download bar showing Meetily Pro DMG file downloading at 1 MB per second
You can also download later from meetily.ai/downloads/pro.
Click "Next: Get License Key" to see your license key (Step 2 of 2). You can:
Copy the key to your clipboard
Download it as a .txt file for safekeeping
The modal also shows activation instructions and important details: the license is valid for one device only and the trial lasts 14 days after activation.
Your License Key modal showing Step 2 of 2 with the license key, Copy button, activation instructions, and validity notes
Copy or download your license key now. It is also sent to your email, but saving it immediately ensures you have it ready for activation.
Follow the same installation steps as Community (see above for macOS or Windows).
The Pro installer is a separate application from Community. You can have both installed simultaneously.
Your 14-day trial begins when you activate the license. The trial is valid for one device only.
Pro Trial features (everything in Community, plus):
Custom AI model connector (use your own LLM)
If you already know you want Pro features, you can purchase directly without starting a trial first.
Click "Buy Now" on the Pro card
You will receive your license key via email instantly
Pricing: $10/user/month billed annually at $120/year (60% off the regular $25/month price).
Click "Download Pro" under the Pro card
Install following the platform-specific steps above
Paste the license key from your purchase confirmation email
Your license is valid for one year from purchase.

children.a: Yes. Meetily Community Edition is completely free and open source under the MIT license. You can download it from meetily.ai/downloads or build from source on GitHub. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually for enhanced features.

children.q: Does Meetily require an internet connection?
children.a: No. Both Community and Pro run 100% locally on your device. Internet is only needed to download the app, for optional updates, and if you choose to use external AI model providers for summary generation.

children.q: Can I install both Community and Pro?
children.a: Yes. Community and Pro are separate applications that can be installed side by side on the same machine.

children.q: What happens when my Pro trial expires?
children.a: After 14 days, Pro features will be disabled. Your recordings and transcripts remain on your device. You can purchase a Pro license to continue using Pro features, or switch to the free Community Edition.

children.q: Does Meetily work with Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet?
children.a: Yes. Meetily captures system audio directly, so it works with any meeting platform including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex, and Slack Huddles. No bot joins your meeting.

children.q: Is my meeting data sent to any server?
children.a: No. All transcription and summarization happens locally on your device. Your audio and transcripts never leave your computer. This is true for both Community and Pro editions.
macOS 11.0+ with Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4), or Windows 10+ with x64 processor. Minimum 8 GB RAM recommended, 16 GB for best performance. About 2 GB of free storage space.

children.q: How do I activate my Pro license key?
children.a: Open Meetily Pro, go to Settings, then Pro, and paste your license key. Click Activate. Your license key is sent to the email you used during purchase or trial signup.
